Who needs to file income tax returns by November 21 deadline? 
 inshorts inshorts Who needs to file income tax returns by November 21 deadline?
 Taxpayers whose business or professional income requires a tax audit must file their income tax returns by November 21 for assessment year 2026-27. This includes businesses crossing applicable turnover thresholds, professionals with gross receipts above ₹50 lakh, companies and LLPs subject to audit requirements.
